purpose_zh: 街道组件库机器可读索引：可移动、可拆卸的公共空间组件及其约束
purpose_en: Machine-readable street component library: movable, removable public-space components and their constraints
boundary_zh: 组件为概念建议，不遮挡文保本体、消防、盲道或交通视距；无采购或部署承诺
boundary_en: Components are conceptual; must not block heritage entities, fire safety, blind lanes or traffic sightlines; no procurement or deployment commitment
constraint_zh: 组件不得遮挡文保本体、消防、盲道或交通视距
honor_system_zh: 荣誉体系只记录可复核贡献：开源代码、公开数据、无障碍修复、公共问题闭环和长期维护
